_comment: 하강 — the trailer, written as shots rather than coordinates.
Every 'from', 'to', 'at' and 'aimTarget' names an object in
Map_FirstSketch_Solo.unity or a keyword DescentFilmRig resolves against the scene
it just opened. There is deliberately not one world coordinate in this file: the
specs this replaces (trailer_frames.json, store_shots.json) hold coordinates probed
on seed 1204's five-storey sanatorium, a map that is no longer generated — that is
checklist.md's blocker B-3.
Keywords, all verified against the shipped scene on 2026-08-04:
centre:<n>                 n = 1..8   (B1 = 1)
chute:<n>:<south|north>    n = 1..7   (7 holes join 8 storeys)
landing:<n>:<south|north>  n = 1..7   where that hole puts you, on the RIM below
gun:<n>                    n = 3..6   ONLY. Four guns, B3-B6, and no others exist
door:<n>                   n = 1..8   one door per storey, all at cell (11,7)
start:<i>                  i = 8..43  ONLY. 36 marks, numbered from 8, not from 1
'aheadMetres' places a body n metres down the bearing the rig measured by raycast,
so a re-seeded storey moves the staging with it. 'standOff' backs the camera away
from an anchor along the corridor that actually leaves it, which is the only way to
frame a dead end without knowing which way the dead end points.
Runner clips, read off Assets/Models/Player/Runner.fbx: Idle Walk Run Crouch
CrouchWalk GunIdle GunWalk Death. A name outside that set now fails the run before
the first frame — see DescentFilmRig.RequireRunnerClips.
Order here is the order of the cut. 23 shots, 1247 frames at 30 fps = 41.57 s,
inside Valve's 30-60 s window with room for the encoder's fades.
docs/store/trailer.md is the prose version and says what each beat has to prove.

shots.name: 01_mouth
shots._beat: Cold open. Stood in the middle of B4, looking down at the 투하구 at your feet.

shots.name: 02_fall
shots._beat: The drop. Chute.FallSeconds 0.5 s over Chute.DropHeightMetres 1.226 m, eased t² by the controller's own gravity. NOT 3 m — that figure was right until 2026-08-03 and is still quoted in stale docs.

shots.name: 03_landed
shots._beat: You are on B5's rim — the far outside of a floor you have not seen. §01: a floor is only ever entered from its own rim, so winning a floor puts you at the back of the next one.

shots.name: 04_start_line
shots._beat: B1's lit outer ring. TWO bodies, not twenty — two is the number of peers that have ever connected, and trailer.md §7 forbids staging a crowd for a claim nobody has demonstrated.

shots.name: 05_inward_rim
shots._beat: The narrowing, 1 of 3: the outer band, where everybody starts and the way in is four gates wide.

shots.name: 06_inward_gate
shots._beat: 2 of 3: the middle gate on B5, the one that carries the floor's only door.

shots.name: 07_inward_centre
shots._beat: 3 of 3: past the last gate, which §12-A holds at one cell wide however big the lobby gets. Everybody arrives at the same doorway. Tighter lens and a flat pitch so it does not repeat 14_surface_b7's framing from the same anchor — the previous cut shipped two shots with byte-identical camera parameters.

shots.name: 08_surface_b1
shots._beat: Eight floors, eight surfaces. Identical relative framing on every storey — the only variable is the floor, so the cut argues for the mix without a caption. No music under this section.

shots.name: 16_gun
shots._beat: A gun on the floor of a dead end. Gun_B4 is a real prefab instance in the shipped scene, placed on a 막힌 길. Camera backs off along the corridor that leaves the cell — a fixed world-axis offset put this shot inside a wall on 2026-08-04.

shots.name: 17_seen_18m
shots._beat: §06's speed ladder, shown as three distances rather than stated as a number. At 16 m it is a shape.

shots.name: 19_seen_6m
shots._beat: It fills the frame and the camera gives ground. The cut lands on 20_back_to_b1 — the juxtaposition IS the rule, because being caught is not death.

shots.name: 20_back_to_b1
shots._beat: Hard cut out of the creature onto B1's lit rim: the cell you started in, eight floors up, still racing. MatchDirector.cs:1614 — 「§02: caught is not death.」 §09's spectator ghost was deleted because nothing is permanent any more.

shots.name: 21_door
shots._beat: One door per floor — 1.1 s to shut, 4.5 s to break, never comes back. The only thing you can do to another runner.

shots.name: 22_finish
shots._beat: The middle of B8. §12-C: B8의 중심은 투하구가 아니라 도착점 — the one place in the building with no hole in it.

shots.name: 23_ring_empty
shots._beat: Close on B1's outer ring with nobody on it, for the title. No burned-in text in the render — trailer.md §7: the plate is added in the edit, not baked into a frame the rig cannot re-cut.
